old_problem: An aggregate eye-margin pass cannot prove that every intended lane on the correct BlueField/ConnectX path was measured at the required generation/equalization context. The target, lane map, method/units, sampling, limits, traffic impact and recovery were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row clearly defines BlueField PCIe eye-margin measurement through NVQual Test #19. Tool revision, stable NIC/path/lane map, generation-specific measurement method and signed per-lane limits are Project Configuration. ED-15 prohibits PASS without limits, while a gated parameterized testcase resolves the review without inventing OEM measurements.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2139, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2140 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00017-V002 / 4205932c53e0c52a was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the licensed pinned Test #19 module, NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF and complete root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane path before the scan.
Pin negotiated generation/width, preset/equalization context, horizontal/vertical axes, units, sampling and signed per-lane limits; do not infer vendor-specific semantics.
Drain dependent traffic, preserve/hash link/AER/NIC/OS/BMC baselines and collect complete untruncated raw values for every required lane with timestamps and threshold comparison.
A generic link-health, BER or aggregate vendor pass does not replace eye-margin coverage; never alter presets, retrain/reset or rerun to force a clean result.
Stop on link loss/downtraining, missing lane/NIC, AER burst, traffic impact, thermal/power fault, hang/reboot, tool failure or evidence gap; follow signed vendor recovery without automatic retry.
No NVQual/eye scan, NIC/link query, traffic drain, log clearing, retrain/reset, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Stable-path per-lane BlueField/ConnectX PCIe eye-margin qualification
test_case.purpose: Measure horizontal and vertical PCIe eye margin for every required lane on the exact BlueField/ConnectX path and prove each meets signed generation-specific limits without link degradation, traffic impact, hang, reboot or new errors.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #19 eye-margin module and compatible NIC firmware/driver
Signed NIC/DPU serial/port/BDF plus root-port/switch/retimer/per-lane stable identity map
Approved generation/width/preset/equalization context and measurement axes/units/sampling
Signed per-lane horizontal/vertical limits and link/AER/NIC/platform acceptance
Dedicated drained SUT, trusted access, thermal/power monitoring, abort and vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and per-lane limits are signed. Preserve/hash baseline link, AER, NIC, OS and BMC evidence and drain the approved traffic scope. Run only the pinned Test #19 module against the bound path; retain complete raw horizontal/vertical measurements for every lane with method, units, generation/equalization context and threshold comparison. Stop on first anomaly; do not change presets, retrain/reset or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every required lane on the exact path is measured in the signed context and meets its approved horizontal/vertical limit; link generation/width, NIC identity/function and traffic state remain acceptable, with no AER burst, thermal/power violation, hang, reboot or disqualifying error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without the exact module, stable path/lane map, method/units and signed per-lane limits. PASS requires complete accepted raw results for every lane plus clean correlated health. FAIL on unmeasured/wrong lane, threshold miss, link loss/downtraining, target mismatch, traffic impact, AER/NIC/platform fault, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; aggregate pass is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until module, target/path/lane map, generation/equalization method, limits, traffic drain and recovery are signed.
Verify stable identity and drain dependent traffic before any link-impacting margin operation.
Preserve baseline evidence and use an isolated SUT with console and thermal/power monitoring.
Stop without preset change, retrain/reset or automatic retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #19 module/license/configuration and authorization
Signed axes/units/sampling/per-lane limits and traffic/link/platform acceptance
Complete raw per-lane horizontal/vertical values and deterministic threshold comparison with timestamps
First-fault/vendor recovery or clean final link/traffic state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On a margin miss, wrong target, link loss/downtraining, AER burst, traffic impact, thermal/power fault or evidence gap, stop the scan and preserve first-fault artifacts. Do not retrain/reset or rescan automatically; follow the signed vendor recovery and quarantine if link identity/health is not restored.
